2.3 REPRODUCTION IN HUMAN BEINGS: WHY REPRODUCTION MATTERS
====

• Specific Learning Outcome(s): By the end of this page, the learner should be able to explain why reproduction matters and apply it in a familiar Kenyan context.
• Key Inquiry Question(s): How does why reproduction matters help us understand the materials and changes around us?

PAGE 1 OF 20: WHY REPRODUCTION MATTERS
====

SECTION 1 — CONCEPT OVERVIEW
----

This page focuses on Why Reproduction Matters. Scope: Continuity of human life age-appropriate.

• 2.3 Reproduction in Human Beings.
• Menstrual cycle consists of natural changes that occur to the body of a female human being every month in preparatio to pregnancy.
• A menstrual cycle lasts between 28-35 days. However, this can vary between female and from one cycle to the next. The cycle depends on hormones.
• Hormones are chemical messengers in the body.
• They direct the body on what to do and when to do it.
• The menstrual cycle is a process controlled by hormones in the female body.  The menstrual cycle is divided in to the following phases:.
• Bleeding from the vagina begins. This is caused by the loss of the lining of the uterus.
• This is called menstruation or monthly periods.
